settings.title: Shipping & returns.
settings.text: Straightforward. No fine print designed to trick you.

settings.title: Free US shipping
settings.text: All US orders ship free via USPS Priority. Tracking number sent within 24 hours of dispatch.

settings.title: Alpha: 2-week dispatch
settings.text: Alpha units are hand-packed and dispatched within 14 days of order. You get a personal note in the box.

settings.title: 30-day returns
settings.text: Unopened units in original packaging. Contact hello@keepkase.com and we sort it same day. No restocking fees.

settings.title: International
settings.text: International orders available at checkout. Duties and taxes calculated at checkout. Not included in listed price.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: US: 3–5 business days via USPS Priority after dispatch. Alpha orders dispatch within 14 days. Standard store orders dispatch within 2 business days.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Contact us within 12 hours of placing your order and we can usually modify or cancel it before dispatch. After dispatch, standard return policy applies.

settings.question: My order arrived damaged. What do I do?
settings.answer: Email hello@keepkase.com with a photo. We ship a replacement same week. No return required for damaged goods.

settings.question: Are alpha units returnable?
settings.answer: Alpha units are final sale given cost-price pricing. If yours arrives defective or damaged, we replace it immediately. Contact us.
